entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?

Hi... yes, hello. I... I have this VeloBand Cadence Sensor and I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the whole process. I was looking on the website and I just couldn't figure it out.
I can definitely help you with that. Just to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it works fine. I think I just... I changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and honestly, I just don't use it. The setup and everything was a little overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I understand completely. Let me just pull up your account to check on the return eligibility. Can I get your order number, please?
Yes, um, hold on... okay, it's VF886-0115.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 7 days ago, on January 13th. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. Is that a problem?
Not at all. According to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's wonderful. That's such a relief, thank you so much. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
That is so much easier. Thank you again, Diana.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
